newsitem.title: CANADA: Nortel wins C$127 mln switch contract.
newsitem.headline: Nortel wins C$127 mln switch contract.

text.p: Northern Telecom Ltd said on Wednesday it won a C$127 million deal from BCE Inc's Bell Canada to finish a modernization program to make Bell's switching network entirely digital by the end of 1997.
The contract would provide improved service and more functions to small and medium-sized communities across Quebec and Ontario, about 10 years earlier than Bell's initial schedule, Nortel said.

Nortel said the deal included hardware, software, engineering and installation services to upgrade first generation digital technology and replace analog switches with Nortel digital switching and transport equipment.
The Nortel technology, including transport equipment manufactured in Montreal, will be installed in 145 localities reaching close to half a million Bell customers.
